summary.title: TicketVault Threat Model
summary.description: TicketVault is a platform that allows people to buy tickets to live events. Customers can sign in through the TicketVault website or application. When the user interacts with the application, it calls on an API that facilitates interactions with the database and with the payment and email/SMS providers. Organizers may also log in to perform administrator actions and view ticket data.

diagrams.title: TicketVault STRIDE Diagram
diagrams.description: Threat model of TicketVault's components, data flows, and trust boundaries
